viewport_notes: the 404 page. It IS an error page by design — but it must be BRANDED + offer a recovery path, never a raw template.

checks.rule: no Liquid/render errors, no missing images, no Lorem/[CLAIM] text — the 404 itself renders cleanly
the 404 is on-brand (logo, colors, type, voice) — not a bare 'page not found' on a white page
a way back exists — search box, primary nav, or links to home/collections — so the shopper isn't dead-ended
no overflow/overlap; the chrome (header/footer) renders normally around the 404 body
